caption:
Starting with their excuse feels gentle, but it muddies the point. Say what happened first, then give them room to answer.

Save this for the deadline talk you keep putting off.

#newmanager #firsttimemanager #leadership #managertips #difficultconversations

slides.label: Stop saying
slides.quote: “I know things have been busy lately...”

slides.headline: It starts with their <u>excuse</u>, not the issue.
slides.sub: Now you’re both talking around it instead of saying what happened.

slides.label: Say this
slides.quote: “The last two deadlines were missed. What got in the way?”

slides.headline: Knowing what to say is the easy part.
slides.sub: Practice saying it with Steady before the real talk.
